about: GitHub (github.com): list trending repositories and developers by language and period, browse topic repositories, and read repository metadata such as languages, contributors, releases, latest commit, branches and README.

commands.summary: List GitHub trending repositories for a period (daily/weekly/monthly) and programming language, with description, language, total stars, forks and stars gained in the period.

params.name: language
params.description: Programming language slug as used in GitHub URLs, lowercase, e.g. python, javascript, rust, c%23 for C#.

params.name: spoken_language_code
params.description: Filter by spoken language of the repo, ISO 639-1 code, e.g. en, zh

commands.summary: List GitHub trending developers for a period and programming language, with their most popular repository.

params.name: language
params.description: Programming language slug, lowercase, e.g. python, go.

commands.summary: List repositories tagged with a GitHub topic, sortable by stars, forks or last update.
Get repository sidebar data: latest release, contributor count and top contributors, language breakdown, dependents count and sponsors.
Get the repository README (rendered HTML) and other overview files for a branch.

params.name: branch
params.description: Branch name, usually the default branch (main or master; see list-repo-refs)

commands.summary: Get the latest commit on a repository's default branch: sha, date, author, message and CI status.
List all branch or tag names of a repository.
Get the number of branches and tags in a repository.
Get the last commit (sha, date, message) for each top-level file and folder of a repository.
Get a repository's sponsorable accounts and external funding links.
